description: Data subjects are not informed about the existence of automated decision-making including profiling, the logic involved, and the significance and envisaged consequences.
applicability: Applicable when automated decision-making produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects data subjects. Includes profiling, algorithmic decisions, and AI-based processing.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of automated decision systems and associated disclosures. Verify meaningful information about logic and consequences is provided.
